summary: 0.2.8-rc.1 brings the experimental control's wire batching and bounded restoration into a prerelease. Extension API 1.0.0 stays unchanged.
changes: Batch plain and CEE property-source wire processing and restore saved wire trees in bounded work windows.
Reuse reviewed geometry, scope restoration holds and retain native numerical and matrix-lifetime safeguards on Windows and Linux.
Add release regressions for twelve logic, memory, supply and heater circuits.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.265, Java 21, Create 6.0.10, CEE 1.1.4, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.11. Set PG multiTicks to 16. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: The combined Pinout Stationary Yard also requires CC:Tweaked 1.121.0 and CC;CPG: Pinout 0.2.1. Circuit fixtures using fuses or rotary selectors require Power Components 1.3.0.
